privacyCenter.title: Privacy Center
privacyCenter.description: Review and execute patient data-subject requests with an auditable approval step.
privacyCenter.emptyDescription: New export, correction, and anonymization requests will appear here.
privacyCenter.emptyFilteredDescription: Adjust the filters or search to review a broader set of requests.

confirm.exportMessage: Generate and download the approved data export for {{patient}}? This action is recorded in the privacy request.
confirm.anonymizeMessage: Permanently remove identifying information for {{patient}}? This action cannot be undone.

privacyCenter.downloadError: The export could not be downloaded.
privacyCenter.resolveError: The request could not be resolved.
privacyCenter.rejectError: The request could not be rejected.
privacyCenter.actionError: The {{action}} action could not be completed.

resolve.title: Resolve correction request
resolve.message: Record what was reviewed or corrected for {{patient}}.
resolve.placeholder: Corrected demographic details after verifying supporting documents.

reject.title: Reject privacy request
reject.message: Record why this privacy request is being rejected.

security.title: Security settings
security.description: Protect your account with multi-factor authentication and review its current status.
security.twoFactorDescription: Require a time-based code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
security.recommended: Recommended for clinical and privileged accounts
security.setupError: Two-factor setup could not be started.
security.scanDescription: Open your authenticator app and scan this code. Do not share the QR code.
security.codeDescription: Enter the six-digit code generated by your authenticator app.
security.invalidCode: The verification code is invalid or expired.

backups.title: Database backups
backups.description: Create, verify, download, and restore protected database snapshots.
backups.generateError: The backup could not be generated.
backups.downloadError: The backup could not be downloaded.
backups.healthDescription: The database connection is active and backup storage is available.
backups.restoreGuardDescription: Encrypted PostgreSQL dumps are restored only through the maintenance runbook. JSON restore is limited to non-production development snapshots and creates a safety backup before changing data.
backups.emptyDescription: Create a manual backup to produce the first snapshot.
backups.partialRestore: Restore completed partially. Unsupported tables were skipped: {{tables}}.
backups.restoreError: The backup could not be restored.
backups.restoreMessage: Restore {{filename}}? The server will create a safety backup first, then overwrite matching development data.
